headline: Ambuja Cements Limited: Shareholders meeting
sum: Shareholders meeting - Ambuja Cements Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Combined Scrutinizer''s Report of NCLT Convened Meeting of Equity Shareholders pursuant to the Order passed by Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal,…
detail: Shareholders meeting - Ambuja Cements Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Combined Scrutinizer''s Report of NCLT Convened Meeting of Equity Shareholders pursuant to the Order passed by Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench in relation to the Scheme of Amalgamation of ACC Limited with the Company.
